findings.narrative: dev-alice can become admin in 2 hops: assumes DevRole via sts:AssumeRole, then passes AdminRole to a new EC2 instance via unrestricted iam:PassRole (Resource: "*"). Once the EC2 instance launches with AdminRole, dev-alice can retrieve admin credentials from the instance metadata service.

ops-bob can escalate to admin across account boundaries: first assumes CrossAccountAdmin in account 222222222222 via a cross-account trust (protected only by a static ExternalId), then pivots back into account 111111111111's AdminRole via a reverse trust relationship. This creates a cross-account admin loop.

findings.pattern_name: Unrestricted PassRole on all IAM roles
findings.narrative: dev-alice holds iam:PassRole with Resource: "*", allowing her to pass ANY role in the account — including AdminRole — to any AWS service that accepts a role parameter. This wildcard grant is the root cause enabling the PassRole+RunInstances escalation chain (F-001).
